workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Visual Debug mode specializes in debugging web pages through Playwright browser automation, combining console log analysis, network interception, and visual screenshot comparison. Uses the Qwen3.6 Abliterated model for vision-based verification.

step.details: Identify the core debugging objective: - Is it a visual/layout bug? → focus on screenshot comparison + computed styles - Is it an auth flow issue? → focus on cookie/token capture + redirect tracing - Is it a REST API flow? → focus on network interception + response validation - Is it a console error? → focus on log capture + stack trace analysis - Is it a user interaction bug? → focus on action replay + state capture

Establish the URL, expected credentials (if auth needed), and browser context. Verify Playwright is available in the environment. Set the model to qwen3.6-abliterated for screenshot verification steps.

Define the sequence of browser actions needed: 1. Launch browser with appropriate configuration 2. Navigate to target URL 3. Capture initial state (console, network, screenshot) 4. Execute the interaction flow step by step 5. Capture post-action state at each step 6. Compare screenshots and console output against expectations 7. Document findings in evidence.md

phase.name: browser_setup
phase.description: Configure and launch the Playwright browser instance

step.title: Select Browser Engine
step.description: Choose chromium (default), firefox, or webkit based on the debugging target

heuristics.heuristic: Chromium for general web debugging and Chrome-specific issues

step.title: Configure Browser Context
step.description: Set viewport size, user agent, and any required storage state (cookies, localStorage). Enable console capture via page.on('console'). Enable network interception via page.route() or page.on('request'/'response').

step.title: Set Up Error Capture
step.description: Register listeners for: - page.on('console') → collect all console.log/warn/error - page.on('pageerror') → capture uncaught JS exceptions - page.on('requestfailed') → capture failed network requests - page.on('response') → capture response status and bodies

phase.name: human_readability_audit
phase.description: CRITICAL: Verify that text content is actually readable by human eyes, not just present in the DOM. An element can pass Playwright's "visible" check (offsetParent !== null) while being nearly invisible to a person due to low contrast, tiny font size, or poor color choices. This phase bridges the gap between "element exists" and "human can read it."
phase.rationale: The gap between "visible in DOM" and "human-readable" is vast. Elements may: - Pass visibility checks but have contrast ratios as low as 1.36:1 (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1) - Use font sizes below 10px that are illegible on most screens - Apply opacity or color that makes text indistinguishable from background - Use colors that are indistinguishable for color-blind users

step.title: Extract Contrast Ratios
step.description: For every text-bearing element, compute the WCAG contrast ratio between text color and background color. Use the WCAG 2.1 formula: L = 0.2126 * R + 0.7152 * G + 0.0722 * B (where R/G/B are linearized sRGB values) Contrast ratio = (L_lighter + 0.05) / (L_darker + 0.05)

thresholds.threshold: Required for body text under WCAG AA. Below this → FAIL for normal-sized text.
Required for text ≥ 18pt bold or ≥ 22pt regular. Below this → FAIL for large text.
WCAG AAA enhanced standard. Below this → WARN, not critical but non-optimal.
WCAG AAA for large text. Below this → WARN for large elements.

step.title: Check Font Legibility
step.description: Verify font size, weight, and family are suitable for reading: - Minimum readable font size: 12px for body text, 10px for UI labels - Font weight below 400 (normal) at small sizes may be illegible - Light font weights (100-300) below 16px are often unreadable

checks.check: fontSize < 12px for body text → WARN "potentially illegible"
fontWeight < 400 AND fontSize < 14px → WARN "light weight too small"
fontWeight < 300 AND fontSize < 16px → FAIL "very light text unreadable"
fontSize < 10px ANY text → FAIL "below minimum readable size"

step.title: Check Opacity/Alpha Transparency
step.description: Text with reduced opacity (rgba with alpha < 1.0) further reduces readability. Combined opacity + low contrast can make text effectively invisible.

checks.check: opacity < 0.5 → FAIL "text is semi-transparent"
opacity < 0.75 AND contrastRatio < 3.0 → FAIL "nearly invisible"
rgba alpha < 0.5 → FAIL "color transparency obscures text"

step.title: Color Blindness Simulation (Conceptual)
step.description: Assess whether color-dependent information is distinguishable for common color vision deficiencies (deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia): - Red/green status indicators (✅/❌) are readable even without color - Color-only conveyors (e.g., "red = error" without icon/text) fail accessibility

checks.check: Status conveyed only by color → FAIL "add icon or text label"
Red/green comparison is sole differentiator → FAIL "use shapes or text"

step.title: Human Readability Scorecard
step.description: Compile all readability metrics into a structured scorecard for evidence.md. Include element-by-element pass/fail for contrast, size, opacity, and color blindness.

phase.name: color_design_audit
phase.description: CRITICAL: Audit the page's color design for dark-theme anti-patterns, WCAG contrast compliance, palette coherence, status indicator visibility, and overall color hierarchy. This phase detects common dark design mistakes WITHOUT being told what's wrong — it proactively flags issues like black text on dark backgrounds, pure white text, invisible status dots, and inconsistent palette lightness steps.
phase.rationale: Dark-themed interfaces frequently contain classic dark design mistakes: pure black backgrounds that cause eye strain, pure white text that causes glare, dark text on dark backgrounds that fails WCAG contrast, and status indicators that are invisible against dark surfaces. The mode must automatically detect and report these issues.

step.title: Extract All Text and Background Color Pairs
step.description: For every visible text-bearing element, extract the exact RGB values of text color and background color. Build a complete color inventory of the page.

step.title: Compute WCAG Contrast and Check Thresholds
step.description: For each color pair, compute the WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio. Apply the correct threshold based on element type (normal text, large text, UI component, decorative).

checks.check: Normal text (< 18pt) → requires ≥ 4.5:1 — FAIL if below
Large text (≥ 18pt bold or ≥ 22pt regular) → requires ≥ 3:1 — FAIL if below
UI components (icons, borders, status dots) → requires ≥ 3:1 — FAIL if below
Decorative elements → no requirement — skip

step.title: Flag Dark Theme Anti-Patterns
step.description: Without being told what's wrong, proactively detect and report these common dark design mistakes:

anti_pattern_checks.check: Pure black background (#000000) → FLAG "causes eye strain; use #212529 instead"
Pure white text (#ffffff) on dark background → FLAG "causes glare; use #dee2e6 instead"
Dark text on dark background (contrast < 4.5:1) → FLAG "nearly invisible"
Status indicators with contrast < 3:1 → FLAG "invisible to low-vision users"
Semantic colors not matching dark-mode reference values → FLAG "needs dark-mode adjustment"
Neutral greys without hue tint → FLAG "add 2-5% brand hue for visual warmth"
Inconsistent lightness steps → FLAG "use systematic 10-step or 12-step scale"
More than 4-5 accent colors → FLAG "too many accents; limit to primary + danger + success + warning"

step.title: Verify Status Indicator Visibility
step.description: Check that status indicators (badges, dots, icons) are visible on dark backgrounds. Extract their background color, compute contrast against parent background, and verify they include non-color cues.

checks.check: Indicator contrast ≥ 3:1 against parent background → PASS
Indicator contrast < 3:1 → FAIL "invisible"
Indicator uses color + icon/text → PASS
Indicator uses color only → FAIL "not accessible to color-blind users"
Indicator distinguishable in grayscale → PASS
Indicator indistinguishable in grayscale → FAIL "relies solely on color"

step.title: Evaluate Palette Coherence and Hierarchy
step.description: Analyze the page's overall color palette for coherence, brand adherence, surface hierarchy, and text hierarchy.

checks.check: All colors belong to same hue family or complementary palette → PASS/FAIL
Primary/accent colors match brand guidelines → PASS/FAIL
Background surfaces incrementally lighter (5-8% lightness steps) → PASS/FAIL
Body text off-white, secondary text ~75% opacity, muted text ~50% opacity → PASS/FAIL

step.title: Color Design Scorecard
step.description: Compile all color design findings into a structured scorecard for evidence.md. Include element-by-element pass/fail for contrast, dark-theme anti-patterns, status indicator visibility, and palette coherence.

phase.name: navigation_and_capture
phase.description: Navigate to the target page and capture baseline state

step.title: Navigate to URL
step.description: Use page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' }) for full page load. For SPAs, wait for specific element to be visible after navigation.
step.validation: Verify page loaded successfully (status code, no crash) Capture the URL after any redirects

step.title: Capture Baseline Screenshot
step.description: Take a full-page screenshot or viewport screenshot depending on the bug type. Save to evidence/ directory with descriptive filename.

step.title: Dump Console Log
step.description: Collect all console messages logged during page load. Filter for warnings, errors, and suspicious messages.

step.title: Capture Network Activity
step.description: Record all API requests and responses made during page load. Identify failed requests and unexpected status codes.

phase.name: interaction_execution
phase.description: Execute the user interaction flow step by step with state capture at each step

step.title: Plan Interaction Sequence
step.description: Break the user's requested flow into individual atomic actions: - Click, type, scroll, hover, select, submit - Each action is a separate step with before/after screenshots

step.title: Execute Action and Capture
step.description: For each atomic action: 1. Capture screenshot BEFORE the action 2. Perform the action using Playwright locator API 3. Wait for any resulting state changes (DOM mutations, network responses) 4. Capture screenshot AFTER the action 5. Capture console output generated by the action 6. Capture any network requests triggered by the action

step.title: Verify Action Result
step.description: Use the Qwen3.6 Abliterated model's vision capabilities to read screenshots and verify: - Visual state matches expected outcome - Console errors are not present - Network requests completed successfully - CSS computed values match intended styles

phase.name: visual_verification
phase.description: Compare intended CSS/design values against rendered reality

step.title: Extract Computed Styles
step.description: Use page.evaluate() to get computedStyle for target elements: - Compare intended CSS values (from stylesheets or design specs) with computed values - Check for layout shifts, incorrect colors, spacing, fonts

step.title: Screenshot Diff Analysis
step.description: Compare before/after screenshots to identify unintended visual changes: - Use pixel comparison or structural diff - Highlight regions with unexpected differences

step.title: Theme Consistency Check
step.description: Verify CSS custom properties resolve to expected values: - Check --var-name values against theme specification - Verify dark/light mode toggle renders correctly

phase.name: evidence_documentation
phase.description: Record all findings in structured evidence files

step.title: Create Evidence Directory
step.description: evidence/{feature-slug}/ with descriptive slug for the current debugging session

step.title: Write evidence.md
step.description: Record for each step: - Action performed - Expected outcome - Observed outcome - Console log excerpt - Network activity summary - Screenshot path - Verdict: PASS / FAIL / INVESTIGATE

step.title: Annotate Screenshots
step.description: For failed verifications, annotate screenshots to highlight the discrepancy. Include bounding boxes around mismatched regions.

completion_criteria.criterion: All requested interaction steps have been executed and captured
Screenshots exist for every distinct action step
Console logs have been captured and analyzed
Network activity has been captured and validated
Visual state has been compared against expected CSS values
Evidence document (evidence.md) is complete and structured
Root cause is identified and documented, or explicitly marked as inconclusive

Handoff task list generated in evidence.md with: - Session state (steps completed, steps remaining) - All evidence paths - Remaining work sorted by priority - Instructions for continuation in a new chat
Project-level TODO list updated with any follow-up work discovered during the debugging session (e.g., fix permissions, add missing files, configure environment).
